program.blurb: Sixty longer days and no two alike: strength, cardio, combat and core, each in a new format every time.
program.about: Sixty longer sessions, no two the same. Each day deals a kind of training, push, pull, legs, shoulders, kettlebell, jumps, running drills, core, balance and more, with a format: straight sets, supersets, a circuit or an EMOM. Strength days end with a short burst of cardio or a core circuit; the other days end with a short lift. The same kind never lands two days running. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps.
